title: Grateful Dead Live at Felt Forum, Madison Square Garden on 1971-12-06

ai_review.summary: Clear soundboard capture of a tight 1971 Felt Forum show, highlighted by soaring Jerry solos and the monster Other One > B McGee > Other One jam.
ai_review.review: The recording is generally crisp for a 1971 SBD source, with only occasional piano‑mic distortion and a brief kick‑drum buzz. Musically the band is tight and energetic, delivering standout performances of Loser, Truckin', Black Peter, Ramble On and an extended Other One > B McGee > Other One sequence that smokes. Overall the show feels high‑energy and well‑structured, making it a favorite among fans despite minor sound quirks.

ai_rating.rationale: Average star rating across 15 reviews is ~4.2; most reviewers praise both performance and sound quality, with only a few noting minor audio flaws.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear and crisp for an analog 1971 SBD, but occasional piano‑mic distortion (Keith), brief buzz on the kick drum, and a cut at the intro of Casey Jones are mentioned.

standout_songs: The Other One > B McGee > The Other One
show_quality.setlist_flow: Tight, well‑structured set with strong song transitions; the band sounds cohesive and the performance mirrors the later European ’72 vibe.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Soaring solo work praised; takes more spotlight with standout ballads and improvisations.
band_member_comments.Phil: Hooks up tightly with Jerry and Keith during extended jams, providing strong bass foundation.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith’s piano mic shows occasional distortion, but his keyboards churn out tumbling rhythms and are noted as having found their place in the band’s sound.
band_member_comments.Drums: Kick drum buzz noted briefly; overall drumming supports the high‑energy flow.
